property_summary: For any initial keeper address and any boolean unpauseDecision, calling pause()/unpause() via the keeper causes C.paused() to reflect the actual paused state (i.e., paused() == expectedPaused after operations); the mutant that forces paused() to always return true violates this when expectedPaused is false (after unpause).
change_summary: Change paused() to always return true instead of reading the _paused state variable.
